title: Cryptographic Entropy
description: Entropy measures how unpredictable a secret or random value is to an attacker. Cryptographic security depends on the entropy actually present in key material, not on whether its output merely looks random.

resources.title: NIST IR 8427: Full Entropy Assumption
resources.notes: Explains unpredictability, min-entropy, and why entropy determines the security strength of random bit generation.

resources.title: BIP 39: Mnemonic Code
resources.notes: Defines the initial entropy sizes and checksum process used to create Bitcoin mnemonic phrases.

resources.title: Technical Deep Dive into the Entropy Issue
resources.notes: A concrete hardware-wallet case showing how a generator can produce plausible output with a much smaller effective search space.
